title: The Operations Monitoring Pipeline
description: A Mermaid pipeline diagram of a security operations data flow: telemetry sources to a collection layer to the SIEM to SOAR to the SOC analyst, with an analyst-to-SIEM feedback loop and a log-retention tiering note.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Describe the stages telemetry passes through from source to SOC analyst.
Explain the analyst-to-SIEM feedback loop and the purpose of tiered log retention.
prerequisites: Basic idea of logs, alerts, and an incident-response workflow

instructionalStrategies: Trace one log event from a source through to an analyst decision, hovering each stage.
Discuss why the feedback edge from the analyst back to the SIEM exists.

assessmentQuestions.question: Why does the collection layer normalize and enrich events before they reach the SIEM?
Why does data move to cheaper, slower storage tiers as it ages rather than being deleted?
